# lodash._arraycopy v3.0.0

The [modern build](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/wiki/Build-Differences) of [lodash’s](https://example.invalid/) internal `arrayCopy` exported as a [Node.js](http://example.invalid/)/[io.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:

```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash._arraycopy
```

In Node.js/io.js:

```js
var arrayCopy = require('lodash._arraycopy');
```

See the [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/3.0.0-npm-packages/lodash._arraycopy) for more details.
